args.query: HikariPool connection pool exhausted JDBC timeout

events.statement: api-gateway p99 latency rose from ~205-215ms (steady 06:00-09:30) to 2148ms avg at the 09:45 bucket and ~4300ms from 10:00 onward; max 4711.85ms.
api-gateway error_rate (5xx) rose from ~0.2% to 3.75% in the 09:48 bucket and settled at ~7.2% from 10:00 onward.
portfolio-service p99 latency rose from ~180ms to 2555.91ms avg in the 09:48 bucket and ~4150ms from 10:00 (max 4575.38ms).
portfolio-service began logging ERROR 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms' at 09:53:19, and HikariPool reports exhaustion with 'total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=43'.
A config change cfg-2207 on portfolio-service set db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 at 2026-03-10T09:52:00Z (author infra-automation, 'Apply cost-optimisation profile small to service datasource').
portfolio-service db_pool_in_use was ~12 connections before the change, then dropped to and pinned at exactly 5.0 for the whole period after 10:00.

The only code deployment in the window is dep-5220 on api-gateway (v9.3.0) at 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z, 'Upgrade envoy filter chain; enable HTTP/2 to upstreams' for portfolio-service and order-service; it is still live with no rollback.
order-service, the other upstream that dep-5220 switched to HTTP/2, shows no latency change: p99 flat ~148-153ms across the whole 08:00-11:59 window.
portfolio-service request_rate was flat at ~560-580 req/s across the incident, with no surge at onset.
portfolio-service cpu_pct stayed flat at ~35-36% and memory_pct at ~57% throughout, showing no resource exhaustion.
api-gateway logs during the incident are dominated by 'upstream timeout portfolio-service GET /v1/portfolio/holdings -> 504', confirming the gateway symptom is downstream of portfolio-service.
The pool exhaustion persisted continuously from 09:53 through the end of data at 11:58, still reporting total=5.

Historical incident HIST-115 (order-service, 2025-09-25) had the same symptom class — 'connection is not available / pool exhausted' — with root cause 'Datasource pool size overridden by a wrong environment profile', category config_change.
A ledger-db latency query failed with an upstream timeout after 3 attempts, so ledger-db health could not be confirmed.
The api-gateway deploy at 08:00 precedes the 09:45-09:52 onset by ~1h45m, and gateway logs show only 1 WARN between 08:00 and 09:53.
